signature_features: Kontakt-1 ERA bricks in chevron rows on the turret front/roof and a block array on the glacis (the B to BV difference)
Low cast rounded turret with 125 mm 2A46-2 gun with thermal sleeve and fume extractor; commander cupola with NSVT 12.7 mm
Six large rubber-tyred road wheels and five return rollers per side, rubber side skirts with flap plates at the front
GTD-1000TF gas turbine: wide rear-deck louvre grille and rear exhaust, snorkel tube stowed on turret rear
Two 200 l drop-tank fuel drums on the hull rear and hinged front mudguard plates
